test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

Conclusions:

I. Some sharks are tunas.

II. No tunas are sharks.
solution:
Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/737f62b6a1ef807e91a2e70e55d867017271211c69b296bcf7a32b88f5942ede.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sharks are tunas. - **False**(because there is no direct relation is given between shark and tuna, so it can be possible only).

II. No tunas are sharks. - **False(**because there is no direct relation is given between shark and tuna, so it can be possible only)

So, the conclusion is Either conclusion (I) or (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

**Note: **

Complementary pair

1) When both the elements of conclusions are the same.

2) When both the conclusions are false individually.

There are only two different types of complementary pairs, which satisfy the condition of either or.

​1) All - Some not

2) No - Some

Here, some + no forms a complementary pair.
